entries.title: Proverbs 19:1
segments: ¶Better is a poor [man] that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:2
segments: ¶Also that a person be without knowledge is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet maketh false steps.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:3
segments: ¶The folly of man distorteth his way, and his heart is irritated against Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:4
segments: ¶Wealth addeth many friends; but the poor is separated from his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:5
segments: ¶A false witness shall not be held innocent, and he that uttereth lies shall not escape.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:6
segments: ¶Many court the favour of a noble; and every one is friend to a man that giveth.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:7
segments: All the brethren of a poor [man] hate him; how much more do his friends go far from him: he pursueth [them] with words, --they are not [to be found].

entries.title: Proverbs 19:8
segments: ¶He that getteth sense loveth his own soul; he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:9
segments: ¶A false witness shall not be held innocent, and he that uttereth lies shall perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:10
segments: ¶Good living beseemeth not a fool; how much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:11
segments: ¶The discretion of a man maketh him slow to anger, and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:12
segments: ¶The king's displeasure is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:13
segments: ¶A foolish son is the calamity of his father; and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:14
segments: ¶House and wealth are an inheritance from fathers; but a prudent wife is from Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:15
segments: ¶Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep, and the idle soul shall suffer hunger.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:16
segments: ¶He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; he that is careless of his ways shall die.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:17
segments: ¶He that is gracious to the poor lendeth unto Jehovah; and what he hath bestowed will he repay unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:18
segments: ¶Chasten thy son, seeing there is hope; but set not thy soul upon killing him.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:19
segments: ¶A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment; for if thou deliver [him], yet thou must do it again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:20
segments: ¶Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:21
segments: ¶Many are the thoughts in a man's heart, but the counsel of Jehovah, that doth stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:22
segments: ¶The charm of a man is his kindness; and a poor [man] is better than a liar.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:23
segments: ¶The fear of Jehovah [tendeth] to life, and he [that hath it] shall rest satisfied without being visited with evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:24
segments: ¶A sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, and will not even bring it to his mouth again.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:25
segments: ¶Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware; reprove the intelligent, and he will understand knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:26
segments: ¶He that ruineth [his] father and chaseth away [his] mother is a son that causeth shame and bringeth reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:27
segments: ¶Cease, my son, to hear the instruction which causeth to stray from the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:28
segments: ¶A witness of Belial scorneth judgment, and the mouth of the wicked swalloweth down iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:29
segments: ¶Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of the foolish.
